# postal address frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:postalAddressFrame`](gmeow-postalAddressFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/postalAddressFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)

The postal/administrative reference frame in which this address is expressed. Functional: an address is expressed in exactly one frame. The default is [`gmeow:referenceFramePostalAddress`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFramePostalAddress.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PostalAddress`](../classes/gmeow-PostalAddress.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
